NewsArticle.Title: Arena Gauntlet
NewsArticle.Content: Yesterday there was an error in the Coliseum Arena Gauntlet. I apologize for the inconvenience. I fixed it. Similarly, "The Letter" was temporarily unavailable. I fixed it, too. Hint: Aingeal begins "The Letter". Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
